svg.title: What starts after a release
svg.desc: A run of the release bot starts after every merge into main, every day and by hand. Only a run that published a release, or finished a draft that an earlier run left, starts the bots that follow a release; every other run only keeps the release pull request current and starts neither. Once the whole run passed, the verification included, its last job starts Issue lifecycle, which closes the issues that the release fixes with its link, except after a prerelease, and Screenshots, which renders the pictures of the new version, except after a beta and where the repository has no scripts/screenshots.sh. Should GitHub not start one, the morning sweep of Issue lifecycle and the weekly run of Screenshots catch up.
